title: Measuring the Routine Reserve Standing on a Keyturn Host Payout Account
content:
Which routine reserves count as standing on a Keyturn Host Payout Account turns on how the account settles and on whether money has lately been freed from it.

| How the account settles | Reserves freed in the last three months | The routine reserves that count as standing |
|---|---|---|
| Only when the host asks | None | Every routine reserve ever taken on the account counts as standing |
| Only when the host asks | One or more | Only the routine reserves taken in the three months up to that day count as standing |
| On any other rhythm | Any | Only the routine reserves taken in the month up to that day count as standing |

A routine reserve is one taken without a particular ground standing against it, as distinct from a reserve taken against an open claim.

## Points of judgement

**An account that settles only when the host asks and has had nothing freed from it in the last three months.** The first row governs and the whole history of routine reserves on the account is taken.

**The same account once a reserve has been freed from it in the last three months.** The second row governs and the stretch summed narrows to the three months up to that day.

**A reserve freed more than three months before that day.** It stands outside the test the first two rows turn on, so an account settling only when the host asks with no release inside those three months sits in the first row however many releases stand further back.

**An account swept on any other rhythm.** The third row governs whatever has been freed from it, and only the routine reserves taken in the month up to that day are counted.

## On hypothetical figures

Take a hypothetical account settling only when the host asks that carries routine reserves of 400.00 USD taken four months ago, 300.00 USD taken two months ago and 200.00 USD taken this month. Where nothing has been freed from it in the last three months the routine reserve standing is 900.00 USD; where something has been freed from it in that period it is 500.00 USD, the reserve taken four months ago standing outside the three months that are summed; and on an account swept on any other rhythm the same entries give 200.00 USD.
